description:
The removal of Ukraine’s popular defense minister, Mykhaylo Fedorov, despite recent military successes, has sparked rare protests in Kyiv and an unprecedented public split within the military over the conduct of the war against Russia.

Meanwhile, Russia has lost thousands of troops for minimal gains over the past year in the Donbas region.
